comment: The Mihawk OS fork the ArtCraft edition builds on, and the commit mihawk/patches applies to with `git am`.

lapy_daemon_sha256.comment: The resident root-access daemon the title ships, built for one title id (tools/build-lapy-validation.py, LLVM 23.1.3, payload SDK v0.42). PPSA99170 is Mihawk OS's own pin (tools/build-production.sh); .github/workflows/daemon.yml rebuilds it to prove the toolchain and builds ArtCraft's.
